svg.title: Frog Pond: find the four landmarks
svg.desc: North-up map with real map coordinates. One is Frog Pond, two is the pavilion, three is Tadpole Playground to the east, and four is the carousel to the west. Pale paths are geographic context, not verified step-free routes. Full details and access unknowns follow the map.
svg.text: Landmarks only · access routes not verified
